ids_are: package-local; not native Brain claim IDs

claims.title: All-label scalar stable ReLU training limit and nonfreezing
claims.statement: For standard iid symmetric alpha-stable weights, 0<alpha<2, one input x=1, no biases, continuous both-layer squared-loss gradient flow at rate (log m)^(2/alpha), normalized output (m log m)^(-1/alpha), the output path converges in C[0,T] to y-(y-F)exp(-Qt). F,Q,D are mutually independent with stated stable transforms; initial full kernel tends to Q+D and positive-time kernel to Q, D>0 a.s.
claims.limits: Scalar fixed-time theorem; no assertion of differing infinite-training-time predictions; no general deep-row closure.

claims.title: Marked-Poisson switching boundary layer
claims.statement: At time s/(log m)^(1/alpha), the scalar kernel converges in J1 on bounded s intervals to C+integral z^2 1{u>0,u+(y-F)zs>0} N(dz,du), with independent marked PPP, F and C.
claims.limits: Scalar, continuous flow; finite microscopic horizon. No interchange of microscopic s to infinity with width needed for the separate macroscopic theorem.

claims.title: Fixed standard-coordinate multi-input training limit
claims.statement: For fixed k=d and x_j=e_j in the iid stable coordinate basis, output paths converge to y_j-(y_j-F_j)exp(-Q_jt), and the kernel is asymptotically diagonal after its initial layer. The exact conditional Laplace transform of Q given F is supplied; the Q vector generally depends on the initial residual sign partition.
claims.limits: Standard coordinate inputs only; not arbitrary orthogonal rotations, nonorthogonal inputs, deep networks or discrete steps. Explicit absorbing flow selection.

claims.title: Annealed fractional-loss decay
claims.statement: For scalar input and 0<p<alpha, expected absolute residual to power p converges uniformly on bounded time intervals to E|y-F|^p exp[-(3c_alpha/2)Gamma(1-alpha/2)(pt)^(alpha/2)]. The limiting expected squared loss is infinite for finite time.
claims.limits: Fractional moments only; no finite-population-MSE or m/time limit interchange claim.

claims.title: Exact gate-event flow solver and 48-path independent audit
claims.limits: alpha=1.5 finite widths do not resolve the predicted kernel limit; negative evidence retained.
